_meta.description: Relic list from the eog.gg database tab (1,128 relics): name, pool (Forest/Mountain/Marsh = Verdantglade/Cinder Ridge/Aqualis; Dragon I-II = Loong Haven phases; Feather I-III = Aethyris; Harpadia I-III; Other = event, shop and misc), element, rarity, main stat, set. WARNING: names are eog's own translations of game data and often differ from the live global client (e.g. it lists 'Lucky Idol' where the game says 'Lucky Statue'); match by pool + element + rarity + stat, not by name. drop_chance is null everywhere: no reachable source publishes it (lootandwaifus.com removed its Sword x Staff pages).
_meta.name_reliability: eog translation, not verified against the global client
